## Void Deck 0.2.12

- The on-screen keyboard now wears the Void Deck skin: a black panel, flat keys with hairline borders, Space Mono labels and a dot-matrix text line. The focused key inverts to solid ink, and the emoji and IME panels are toned down to match.
- Steam renames its CSS classes on every update, so Void Deck now asks the running Steam windows for the names they actually use. Anything Steam loads late — the keyboard, for one — is picked up and themed a moment after it appears.
- Fixes the browser preview, which could not build because of a missing asset module.

**Install / update:** Decky → ⚙ → Developer → *Install Plugin from ZIP*, then select `VoidDeck-v0.2.12.zip` from this release.
